result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because it gives Vendor the same consent-free affiliate and successor assignment rights as Customer, and it permits assignment to a Customer competitor with consent rather than prohibiting it outright. It also misses the fallback because successor assignments require no written notice. The mutual affiliate carve-out unnecessarily expands Vendor’s rights beyond either playbook position and may ambiguously bypass the competitor restriction. Unrelated terms are preserved, but the margin comment does not accurately address these operative deviations.
